## Power

For our first power, we take [Pulsar Plus](item_4795ae1f-580d-47ec-a01d-0933cba56212) as it gives us an extra use of our most powerful ability.

## Items

**Buy**

To make the most of our extra charge of pulsars, we are going to be focusing on building AP this round.

- We take  [Power Playbook](item_6d8803cf-baa7-46ee-af91-51e7f2301418) for direct AP boost.

- [Charged Plating](item_b8ca58e7-6ae2-40ee-8618-fe2f32315295) is an item that I don't see talked enough about but in testing I've found it to be really powerful in the first two rounds. As soon as you use your Ult you get a boost to AP, binging you to 20 AP, which is the biggest boost any stat can get at this point. Combine this with double pulsars, and it becomes a very powerful cash grab early on.

- Lastly, we take  [Heartbeat Sensor](item_2a4ffaf4-f14b-47d2-a267-0a0e83e87418). This item gives us some extra mobility, which can be a gamechanger at this point in the game, from helping with snap repositioning for maximizing the value of our pulsars, to giving us a slight defensive edge to stay alive.

**Optionals**

- I don't usually like planning for death, specially not in Stadium, but if you either don't trust your teammates (i.e. solo queuing), or the enemy team is dive-heavy, having at least two of:  [D.Va](hero_e8e1dc68-45c4-47c2-b421-95e33594e6b6),  [Reaper](hero_0449752f-1c58-487b-b9a0-ca727d784457), or  [Genji](hero_31fd201d-2f46-41e4-b125-9fa9e55fed46), then it could be a good idea to forgo  [Heartbeat Sensor](item_2a4ffaf4-f14b-47d2-a267-0a0e83e87418) and instead take  [Winning Attitude](item_8714087c-c078-4619-a2ef-327bc6edaa69). Every time you die you get 15% ult charge, which at this point goes a long way for activating our  [Charged Plating](item_b8ca58e7-6ae2-40ee-8618-fe2f32315295).

## Playstyle

At this point in the game your main focus is to farm cash and building your Ult to get the most of  [Charged Plating](item_b8ca58e7-6ae2-40ee-8618-fe2f32315295). This means keep your team healed and clean up kills as you go. The most impactful survival item you can get at this point (and really, ever) is good positioning, so stay out of trouble, stay safe on the high ground as much as possible and make sure to always stay at most a Glide Boost away from the rest of your team. 

Your pulsars are your best friends in this round and thankfully they are very good at keeping your team up and your enemies down while staying safe. Use the most of your cooldowns for them and make sure to keep shooting your team while waiting for them to come back up. 

Taking  [Winning Attitude](item_8714087c-c078-4619-a2ef-327bc6edaa69) does not mean play reckless to farm Ult, but it is rather meant as an insurance policy if you do happen to die.

## Items

From now on I'll mostly be listing the essentials for the build in the *"Buy"* and *"Keep"* sections of items, thinking of the low end of cash per round, but look in the *"Optionals"* section for stronger items that help the build truly bloom.

At this point there is not a lot of utility that we can gain from items, so instead we will focus on building raw  [Ability Power](stat_ability_power).

**Sell**
- If you took  [Winning Attitude](item_8714087c-c078-4619-a2ef-327bc6edaa69) on round 1, sell it. It is too expensive for what it is and from this point forward it really is up to us to stay alive and farm ult ourselves.  [Heartbeat Sensor](item_2a4ffaf4-f14b-47d2-a267-0a0e83e87418) should also be sold if you can't otherwise afford our two new items for the round.

**Keep**

- We keep  [Power Playbook](item_6d8803cf-baa7-46ee-af91-51e7f2301418) and  [Charged Plating](item_b8ca58e7-6ae2-40ee-8618-fe2f32315295) as they have the best AP-to-cash ratio and function as a decent base for building AP this round.

**Buy**
- We're building raw AP, and given that we already have the two common items that grant AP, the next step is to get  [Nano Cola](item_79b22609-8046-4a8a-a5a2-bb49cd7e11c6).
- We want another AP item, and at this point we take  [Custom Stock](item_17d633af-8bcc-4893-b865-be0a7bc66fe2) as it is the cheapest option and it gives us some extra power for our gun.

**Optionals**
- If you have enough cash, you can forgo  [Custom Stock](item_17d633af-8bcc-4893-b865-be0a7bc66fe2) and instead take  [Multi-Tool](item_5ba8d94e-f2f3-44b7-8773-025fc6ed7c56), as the  [Cooldown Reduction](stat_cooldown_reduction)  is definitely more useful to us than the WP.
- Likewise, if you can afford it, take/keep  [Heartbeat Sensor](item_2a4ffaf4-f14b-47d2-a267-0a0e83e87418). I won't mention it every round, but from now on this item is a good go-to optional if you have the room for an extra item, as it helps compensate for the mobility nerfs Juno has suffered.

If you are somehow *Rich* rich, and can still afford more on top of the previously mentioned, here's a couple items that can work nicely, depending on your cash.
-  [Weapon Grease](item_961ae72f-434f-406b-a89b-ab8efec806bf), for a little extra healing from our gun
-  [First Aid Kit](item_0172eaaa-1902-44a3-b989-d12f0f7301da) or  [Adrenaline Shot](item_ab8eba6a-0bda-4b12-8854-4ba4169b515f) for some extra survivability
-  [Energized Bracers](item_f83a1d9e-91f8-4d2c-bd62-c673b8d9fd2e) for extra  [Ability Power](stat_ability_power) and some survivability in the form of  [Ability Lifesteal](stat_ability_lifesteal).

## Playstyle

Pretty much the same as round 1, but with now even more focus on our pulsars. After using our Ult we effectively have 50%  [Ability Power](stat_ability_power) , which is insane for round 2, so go crazy on those pulsars and farm that cash!

## Power

This time around we take  [Blink Boosts](item_9bac3119-781b-4dc0-94fa-9c293c02dc90). This will be our main mobility upgrade for the build, as well as giving us two extra cooldowns. 

## Items

**Keep/Sell**

- We keep  [Power Playbook](item_6d8803cf-baa7-46ee-af91-51e7f2301418) and  [Charged Plating](item_b8ca58e7-6ae2-40ee-8618-fe2f32315295) as our  [Ability Power](stat_ability_power) baseline.
- Sell everything else. We are starting fresh this round.

**Buy**

- In this round we get the first of our core items for the build, [Mark of the Kitsune](item_09a53e39-25aa-4f66-ba51-bedbc543a1eb). This will keep our gun relevant for the rest of the game, as it now effectively scales up with our  [Ability Power](stat_ability_power).
- We also take our first survival item, [Ironclad Exhaust Ports](item_2d085fa5-ace6-4fab-9323-b7a06268bcd0) 

**Optionals**

- If you have the cash,  [Multi-Tool](item_5ba8d94e-f2f3-44b7-8773-025fc6ed7c56) and  [Nano Cola](item_79b22609-8046-4a8a-a5a2-bb49cd7e11c6) are better than  [Custom Stock](item_17d633af-8bcc-4893-b865-be0a7bc66fe2) and should replace it if possible.
- If you can afford it,  [Heartbeat Sensor](item_2a4ffaf4-f14b-47d2-a267-0a0e83e87418) is a good option to fill that sixth slot as usual. 

## Playstyle

Now that we have [Blink Boosts](item_9bac3119-781b-4dc0-94fa-9c293c02dc90) and  [Mark of the Kitsune](item_09a53e39-25aa-4f66-ba51-bedbc543a1eb) we want to make the most of our cooldowns to get as much of a boost on our gun as possible. Make sure to cycle cooldown-gun-cooldown-gun to really get the most out of your kit. Only the first bullet that we **hit** after using a cooldown will have the boost, so this means that our aim need not be super demanding. In fact, since each round of your blaster fires multiple bullets, you are likely to have a much better time flicking your crosshair to ensure that at least one of your bullets hits the target.

Also, a thing that is worth pointing out is that thanks to  [Mark of the Kitsune](item_09a53e39-25aa-4f66-ba51-bedbc543a1eb), the effect of the falloff on our weapon is greatly diminished, as the bonus from the item is unaffected by this. With this in mind, I like playing a good distance away from the action, either from high ground, or in the back, as this will allow us to see most of our teammates and enemies, making our pulsars a lot more effective, while also keeping us safe, and thanks to  [Blink Boosts](item_9bac3119-781b-4dc0-94fa-9c293c02dc90) we are now a lot sneakier and thus much harder to dive. At this point if you position well, you won't really die for the rest of the match.

## Items

**Sell**
- It is now time to get rid of [Charged Plating](item_b8ca58e7-6ae2-40ee-8618-fe2f32315295), as we can now consistently get more  [Ability Power](stat_ability_power) without having it depend on using our Ult.

*Keep*
-  [Mark of the Kitsune](item_09a53e39-25aa-4f66-ba51-bedbc543a1eb) (core item)
-  [Power Playbook](item_6d8803cf-baa7-46ee-af91-51e7f2301418) and whichever one out of  [Custom Stock](item_17d633af-8bcc-4893-b865-be0a7bc66fe2) or  [Multi-Tool](item_5ba8d94e-f2f3-44b7-8773-025fc6ed7c56) you can afford. ([Ability Power](stat_ability_power))
-  [Ironclad Exhaust Ports](item_2d085fa5-ace6-4fab-9323-b7a06268bcd0)* (Survivability) (*See Optionals)

**Buy**
- We now take our second core item for the build, [Lumerico Fusion Drive](item_3da81000-333c-460a-a1a2-09441bfda9c8). It boosts our  [Ability Power](stat_ability_power) while giving us some more survivability tied to our usage of cooldowns.

**Optionals**

[Ironclad Exhaust Ports](item_2d085fa5-ace6-4fab-9323-b7a06268bcd0)  is a decent all-around survival item for our build, but its meager 25 overhealth progressively gets less and less impactful, so now that we take  [Lumerico Fusion Drive](item_3da81000-333c-460a-a1a2-09441bfda9c8), feel free to change it for something that might be more tailored to the specific context of your match. 

For example, if most of your enemies are building WP and/or taking  [Aerial Distresser](item_0fcb9020-c729-49b9-b398-3223797b6204), then [Crusader Hydraulics](item_b64cee07-ca32-405d-987e-868b415bbc09) would be much more effective as a rare survival item at this point. The armor from it is placed behind your shields, so its damage reduction applies for a *significant* portion of your health total.

Also, as per usual, [Heartbeat Sensor](item_2a4ffaf4-f14b-47d2-a267-0a0e83e87418), if you can afford it.

## Playstyle

Much the same as last round. Do be careful about taking too many risks. We may have more survivability, but our enemies also have more power.

## Power

We now take  [Stinger](item_e9d0d530-d620-4e74-a34d-38cdebfeb9a4), the second and last directly gun-related upgrade of this build. This has some insanely good interactions that give us some insane utility. I pray this doesn't get nerfed soon (let's be real, they hate Juno being powerful so they probably will), but while we can, we might as well capitalize on it.

## Items

**Keep**

-  [Mark of the Kitsune](item_09a53e39-25aa-4f66-ba51-bedbc543a1eb) (core item)
-  [Lumerico Fusion Drive](item_3da81000-333c-460a-a1a2-09441bfda9c8) (core item)
-  Whichever you picked out of [Ironclad Exhaust Ports](item_2d085fa5-ace6-4fab-9323-b7a06268bcd0) or  [Crusader Hydraulics](item_b64cee07-ca32-405d-987e-868b415bbc09)
-  [Power Playbook](item_6d8803cf-baa7-46ee-af91-51e7f2301418) and either  [Custom Stock](item_17d633af-8bcc-4893-b865-be0a7bc66fe2) or  [Multi-Tool](item_5ba8d94e-f2f3-44b7-8773-025fc6ed7c56), depending on your cash. ([Ability Power](stat_ability_power))

**Sell**

We don't really have room for  [Heartbeat Sensor](item_2a4ffaf4-f14b-47d2-a267-0a0e83e87418) anymore so it's time to part ways with it, but that's fine since we now have more mobility and survivability.

Also, if you cannot afford either of the three core items for the build at this point, sell whatever isn't a core item to be able to afford them. I usually prefer to sell our [Ability Power](stat_ability_power) building items, since our core items will give us some back.

**Buy**

- It is time for our third core item, [Cybervenom](item_210a8582-91ec-4cf3-968a-a443f3a0c505). Combined with  [Stinger](item_e9d0d530-d620-4e74-a34d-38cdebfeb9a4), any bullet of ours that hits an enemy applies healing reduction, which at this point is pretty much necessary to counter the growth of our enemy supports.

## Playstyle

With  [Cybervenom](item_210a8582-91ec-4cf3-968a-a443f3a0c505) and  [Stinger](item_e9d0d530-d620-4e74-a34d-38cdebfeb9a4), the recommendation to flick your gun is now even more present. Since Stinger's damage does not stack on an enemy, it is much better for damage farming to try to apply it to as many enemies at once as possible, which at the same time makes it so that we can apply the healing reduction to as many enemies at the same time. The fact that  [Cybervenom](item_210a8582-91ec-4cf3-968a-a443f3a0c505) can be applied by any hit of our gun is crazy, as it can far outpace the cleansing provided by a  [Voidhoppers](item_d4ce0c76-2500-40d6-b066-dca303be097f)  [Moira](hero_7fb6ff1e-a193-40c0-bd0a-25c1928fbaed) or even a  [Two-Zu](item_80f16d3e-a4c0-4fa8-90b1-a0f033a1a77b)  [Kiriko](hero_70a0ac5c-2a55-4fab-beeb-2f570886426f).

## Items

**Keep**

- [Mark of the Kitsune](item_09a53e39-25aa-4f66-ba51-bedbc543a1eb) (core item)
- [Lumerico Fusion Drive](item_3da81000-333c-460a-a1a2-09441bfda9c8) (core item)
- [Cybervenom](item_210a8582-91ec-4cf3-968a-a443f3a0c505) (core item)
- Whichever rare survival item you have out of  [Ironclad Exhaust Ports](item_2d085fa5-ace6-4fab-9323-b7a06268bcd0) or  [Crusader Hydraulics](item_b64cee07-ca32-405d-987e-868b415bbc09) 
- *One* extra  [Ability Power](stat_ability_power) boosting item, according to your cash.  [Multi-Tool](item_5ba8d94e-f2f3-44b7-8773-025fc6ed7c56)   [Custom Stock](item_17d633af-8bcc-4893-b865-be0a7bc66fe2)   [Power Playbook](item_6d8803cf-baa7-46ee-af91-51e7f2301418) 

**Sell**

To make room to continue building up, we need to sell one of our  [Ability Power](stat_ability_power) items. Priority as above, according to your cash.

**Buy**

For this round, we don't exactly get a core item, as there's two options that I like to take here, but whichever we pick, we'll keep into the last round or switch for the other if need be.

- *Option 1:*  [Iridescent Iris](item_b7fb28ef-ce82-416b-8693-01c274f8df4e) is super good in terms of the raw stats it gives us. A good boost to our  [Ability Power](stat_ability_power) AND our [Cooldown Reduction](stat_cooldown_reduction) is very powerfull and it makes this our all-around good option.

- *Option 2:* This is our more situational option, but in the situations where it's good,  [Liquid Nitrogen](item_a8d99526-05a3-4405-babb-b025479b1b98) can absolutely destroy your opponents. These situations will mostly include ones where your enemies rely on having free movement, such as when facing a  [Reinhardt](hero_a3b6ca2c-6cbd-43dc-bb78-a728e42fba49) or a  [Junker Queen](hero_4794d288-27d9-49e0-a1dd-ffe0f4de3ab1).


## Playstyle

Much the same as last round, shoot your gun and try to hit as many enemies as possible, specially if you took  [Liquid Nitrogen](item_a8d99526-05a3-4405-babb-b025479b1b98). Make sure not to neglect healing and speeding up your teammates though!

## Power

For our last power we take  [Torpedo Glide](item_b04180a3-c2b2-409c-959e-77e3af6bc7d8), as it can drastically reduce the cooldown on our pulsars, which is what we need to secure this round in our favor.

## Items 

**Keep**

-  [Mark of the Kitsune](item_09a53e39-25aa-4f66-ba51-bedbc543a1eb) (core item)
-  [Lumerico Fusion Drive](item_3da81000-333c-460a-a1a2-09441bfda9c8) (core item)
-  [Cybervenom](item_210a8582-91ec-4cf3-968a-a443f3a0c505) 
-  [Iridescent Iris](item_b7fb28ef-ce82-416b-8693-01c274f8df4e) or [Liquid Nitrogen](item_a8d99526-05a3-4405-babb-b025479b1b98) (core item)

**Sell**

- Whichever you have out of  [Ironclad Exhaust Ports](item_2d085fa5-ace6-4fab-9323-b7a06268bcd0) or  [Crusader Hydraulics](item_b64cee07-ca32-405d-987e-868b415bbc09) 

- Whichever  [Ability Power](stat_ability_power) boosting item you have at this point. (This is just so you can directly visualize how much free cash you have at this point.

**Buy**

- We take our last core item, [Boosted Rockets](item_c3e0738f-cce2-431a-ad52-39176df84923) to replace our rare survival item. Due to the nerfs this no longer gives us unlimited flight, but this will still greatly help us make the most of  [Torpedo Glide](item_b04180a3-c2b2-409c-959e-77e3af6bc7d8), while keeping us alive with the absolute 10% damage reduction.

For our sixth slot, we fill it up with an [Ability Power](stat_ability_power) boosting item, depending on what we can afford. The following list progresses in cost and utility to us, meaning that the lowest item on this list is the best and most expensive and the highest is the cheapest and least impactful.

-  [Power Playbook](item_6d8803cf-baa7-46ee-af91-51e7f2301418) 
-  [Custom Stock](item_17d633af-8bcc-4893-b865-be0a7bc66fe2) 
-  [Multi-Tool](item_5ba8d94e-f2f3-44b7-8773-025fc6ed7c56)

-  [Catalytic Crystal](item_3e3f4f77-cdf8-4dda-a5b0-2fb9390aefc4) (I know this is technically 5% less AP than Nano Cola, but the extra 20% building to Ult is absolutely worth it)
-  [Iridescent Iris](item_b7fb28ef-ce82-416b-8693-01c274f8df4e) (if you don't have it already)
-  [Champion's Kit](item_8682f8c7-8811-439b-8d50-fa81cd43ddce)

## Playstyle

This is the peak of our build. Keep playing in much the same way you have this whole time. Make sure that if you're going to be visible to your enemies you have a couple cooldowns of your gliders available to be able to get in and out safely. Keep shooting as much as you can and keep track of your pulsars, as they will now be available to you a lot sooner than you might expect. Have fun and good luck!
